instruction: Run `node "$HOME/Desktop/sherpa-onnx-tts.cjs"` in Terminal to synthesize the sentence "Package pickup is ready at the front desk." as speech. Save the resulting WAV file to "$HOME/Desktop/sherpa_tts_1_2.wav".
reference_command: SHERPA_ONNX_RUNTIME_DIR="$HOME/.openclaw/tools/sherpa-onnx-tts/runtime" SHERPA_ONNX_MODEL_DIR="$HOME/.openclaw/tools/sherpa-onnx-tts/models/vits-piper-en_US-lessac-high" node "$HOME/Desktop/sherpa-onnx-tts.cjs" -o "$HOME/Desktop/sherpa_tts_1_2.wav" "Package pickup is ready at the front desk."
